industry.why: Neutral, carried unchanged as a judgement on an absence. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): no source spoke to defence this week (the thematics and sectors reports both list it as unspoken), so the last demand read is the 9-Oct-26 one (DNB Carnegie and Barclays, 'stronger for longer', book-to-bill near three times) and it is two weeks old; against it Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: F now, D prior at industry level and F on both sectors, the second reading at F. Orders up, shares down, nothing new on either side: the row does not move on an absence. One live holding, Theon (4.05%), judged in component 4. Counter-case: a market with no settled view on an industry is one to Underweight until it settles, and two readings at F is the market's view. Moves to D on a third reading at F with no demand read in the sources.

sector.why: Neutral, carried unchanged as a judgement. Component 1 regime, 9-Oct-26 (late-cycle rates squeeze turning into a European credit-and-sovereign stress episode: hiking path re-marked up, credit joined rates, French spread 152 basis points, European breadth at three-year lows on all four averages, index 5.3% off its high, defensives turning over one and four weeks but unconfirmed, growth firm at the level; sources present 2026-W41): large, proven, government-contracted cases with demand up on this week's sources (DNB Carnegie, 6 Oct; Barclays, 6 Oct; none sceptical), against Rheinmetall minus 16 points relative over 30 days and 51% below its one-year high on the turning note's falling side. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-09 against 2026-08-07, not week on week: F now, B prior, read on the level not the weekly rank. Counter-case: a market with no settled view is one to Underweight until it settles; back to B if sell-side momentum on the primes turns up with the shares.

geography.why: Double Underweight, carried unchanged on this week's reading. Goldman Sachs (16 Oct) has French spreads at decade highs with tentative spillover to Italy and judges France's fiscal challenge 'harder now than in 2011-15'; the premium in basis points was not read, so the reversal conditions (back to D under 120 basis points, to C under 100) could not be tested and are plainly not met at a decade high. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43). Relative strength is not graded by country; no live holding is French-listed. Counter-case unchanged: a country letter is a blunt tool on 110 stocks and lands on French-listed global businesses (TotalEnergies, whose memo exposures lift its Thematic Fit/Momentum by two grades through the stock layer; Soitec; Sopra Steria; Alten) as hard as on domestic banks and property; and Goldman's own judgement is that disorderly escalation is less likely than in 2011-15.
